ref.locator: Exposé général, §3.2 'Crédits de liquidation', table by division organique and programme (PDF p. 16-17): 11.031, 12.029, 09.018, 09.020
ref.quote: 11.031 Gestion du personnel | 12.029 Gestion du Digital | 09.018 Tourisme | 09.020 Commerce extérieur et investisseurs étrangers
ref.note: Residual line. Staff pay (11.031) is the biggest part and follows statutory pay scales and indexation, so a change mostly works through hiring. The digital phrase is grounded in Doc. 591 (2025-2026) N° 1 annexe 6 – Exposé particulier afférent aux compétences de la Ministre de la Fonction publique, de la Simplification administrative et des Infrastructures sportives (https://nautilus.parlement-wallon.be/Archives/2025_2026/BUDGET/bud36.pdf), programme 12.029 'Gestion du Digital', objective (PDF p. 35: 'Le SPW Digital a pour objectif d'offrir à l'ensemble du SPW [...] les outils et moyens visant la digitalisation des compétences'). Tourism is grounded in Doc. 591 (2025-2026) N° 1 annexe 7 – Exposé particulier, Ministre du Tourisme, du Patrimoine et de la Petite enfance (https://nautilus.parlement-wallon.be/Archives/2025_2026/BUDGET/bud37.pdf), programme 09.018 objective (PDF p. 14: financing of Tourisme Wallonie and VISITWallonia); export support in wal-aju-2026-ep-economie-emploi, programme 09.020 table (PDF p. 11: 'Dotation à l'AWEX'). Parts are not freely adjustable: the dotations to the Walloon Parliament and Ombudsman (01.002, 01.003), the transfer to the German-speaking Community for transferred competences (DF 091.049, set by law) and the provision for EU co-financing (DO 36). Also includes ministerial cabinets (DO 02), external relations, the CESE Wallonie, the regulator CWaPE and the tax and budget administration (DO 19 excl. debt). corrected: programme labels confirmed in the exposé général table (PDF p. 16-17). Added the documents that describe what the digital, tourism and export programmes fund (bud36 p. 35, bud37 p. 14, bud35 p. 11) to the caveat; bud36 added under sources. FR export phrase shortened. Phrases otherwise confirmed.
